info.title: Switchfin
info.author: dragonflylee
info.details: Switchfin is third-party PC player for Jellyfin that provides a native user interface to browse and play movies and series.\nSupported media items: movies, series, seasons, episodes\nDirect play and transcoding

changelog:
v0.9.5
Added

- add resume download with HTTP range/ETag support and progress bar for cancelled items
- auto-download subtitles and fallback subtitle URL when DeliveryUrl is missing
- add configurable download path setting

 Fixed

- support the new Quick Connect API (272)
- PS4: fix bitmap subtitle bluescreen (271)
- image: keep texture owned by cache and trim near-white border bars causing smears (243)
- websocket: harden receive loop, reconnect on normal close and fix teardownt
- compare versions numerically in update check
- keep nvtegra decode frames alive across hwaccel reinit
- svg: fix crash when toggling fullscreen on macOS (165)
- danmaku: reset on-screen danmaku after seeking to prevent overlap (163)

v0.9.4
Added

- add eBook viewer with MuPDF support
- add local file gallery viewing
- add unplayed item count badge to media cards

 Fixed

- improve websocket receive loop to handle stop condition correctly
- PS4: improve shader handling of libmpv

v0.9.3
Added
add chapter select on player view
add config for max nextup
add soft keyboard support for trimui

Fixed
show 'Title - Language' in subtitle/audio track selector, matching Jellyfin style (#236) @mr-brune
change seek parameter type from int64_t to double for improved precision
remove unused lastProgress assignment in VideoProgressSlider constructor
i18n: sync missing translation keys across all languages
